name: Metrology and inspection tool
description: Generic fab metrology/inspection tool: EFEM with mini fan filter and two load-port zones on the +X face, measurement enclosure with smoked window and XY stage, hideable column and opticalHead variants, electronics rack, status screen, lp1/lp2/signalTowerMount locators, lod1 sibling. Clip StageScan (4 s loop).
